 F1 LIVE 
 LIVE – Follow the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix in Austin with live text commentary 
 Mathieu Chambenoit 
 Published on 25 / 10 / 2026 at 20: 03 
 Modified on 25/10/2026 at 20:33 
 Comment 
 © DPPI 
 Follow the 2026 F1 United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas in Austin with live commentary.
 20:30 
 Before the Grand Prix, it's difficult to know the pecking order in the race. Charles Leclerc did, however, mention the significant progress made by Mercedes after qualifying.
 Leclerc: "Mercedes has taken a big step forward, more than anyone else." 
 20:25 
 At Ferrari , the reconnaissance laps were carried out on soft tires for Lewis Hamilton .
 20:21 
 The pit lane opens in Austin!
 20:15 
 📊 And speaking of which, truly decisive this Sunday, here is the starting grid for tonight's Grand Prix!
 The starting grid for the 2026 Formula 1 United States Grand Prix in Austin 
 20:05 
 📊 To be precise, a victory for Kimi Antonelli alone wouldn't be enough. Lewis Hamilton is expected to finish this GP 5th or lower, while George Russell is expected to finish 9th or lower. So, nothing is guaranteed for the Italian yet!
 20:04 
 🏆 Indeed, what is at stake tonight is nothing less than a title! At 20 years old, Kimi Antonelli could become the youngest champion in Formula 1 history this afternoon if he wins.
 20:00 
 👋 Good evening everyone! We welcome you to this live coverage of the US Grand Prix in Austin! The day is ending in France, but the afternoon is starting in Texas, and it could well be historic!
